name: dynamicqr-api
description: A QR-code that can change where it points to

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run copyenv
scripts.docker:build: npm run docker:clean;  docker build -t dynamicqr .
scripts.docker:create: docker create --init --cap-add=SYS_ADMIN -e API_URL=http://localhost:3000 -e UI_URL=http://localhost:8080 -e IS_DOCKER=1 -h DynamicQR --name DynamicQR --privileged -p 3000:3000 -p 8080:8080 --restart on-failure:3 dynamicqr:latest
scripts.docker: npm run docker:build && npm run docker:create && npm run docker:start
scripts.docker:clean: docker stop DynamicQR && docker rm DynamicQR && docker rmi dynamicqr:latest
scripts.docker:mongo: npm run docker:mongo:pull && npm run docker:mongo:start

author: Inimi
